description: Centroid-0: fresh decisions should rank by v2 score (recency*salience). Non-contradicted beat contradicted.
score_derivation: v2 = cosine(~1) * recency * (0.7+0.1*salience) * (0.7 if open contradiction). Centroid-0 only (cross-centroid cosine ~0). Decision halflife=60d.

description: Centroid-0: contradicted thoughts (contradictionA,B) must rank BELOW non-contradicted centroid-mates (freshDecisionAlpha1,2) under v2 penalty factor 0.7.
score_derivation: Same 4 thoughts as q-fresh. The critical test: contradicted (score 0.624/0.727) rank below non-contradicted (1.087/0.977). MRR captures ordering.

description: Centroid-1: supersededA (score would be ~0.059 if included) is EXCLUDED by v2 default (include_superseded=false). 3 remaining expected.
score_derivation: v2 applies include_superseded=false, so supersededA is filtered out (WHERE NOT EXISTS). Cluster-1 only. Decision halflife=60d, insight halflife=60d.

description: Centroid-5: 400-day-old salience-5 decision. Recency floor at 0.05 ensures score=0.06 > 0. Must appear in top-10 despite extreme age.
Centroid-0 + filter_project=alpha. All cluster-0 thoughts are alpha; non-alpha cross-centroid thoughts already cosine~0. Verifies filter doesn't break results.
score_derivation: Same cluster-0 scores plus WHERE filter_project='alpha'. All cluster-0 are alpha so result unchanged.

description: Centroid-7: fresh 7-day-old insight, salience 4, beta project. v2 recency gives score 1.015.
score_derivation: v2: recency = exp(-ln2*7/60) = 0.922. salience = 0.7+4*0.1 = 1.1. score = 0.922*1.1 = 1.015. Insight halflife=60d.

description: Centroid-0, DEFAULT params (include_archived=false): archivedAlphaNote excluded. Same expected set as q-fresh-alpha-decision.
score_derivation: Same cluster-0 scores as q-fresh-alpha-decision. DEFAULT include_archived=false in v2 RPC filters archivedAlphaNote out (AND (include_archived OR t.lifecycle_status != 'archived')).

description: Centroid-0 with include_archived=true: archivedAlphaNote (score 0.040) appears alongside the 4 existing centroid-0 thoughts. 5 expected, all in top-5.
score_derivation: Same cluster-0 scores plus archivedAlphaNote (score 0.04). Note halflife=30d (type_mult=1.0). recency=max(exp(-ln2*400/30),0.05)=0.05. salience=0.7+1*0.1=0.8. score=0.05*0.8=0.04. passthrough include_archived=true in v2 RPC params skips the archived filter.
